summary: E2E verified the new 'Tambah Pertanyaan' feature on Master Pertanyaan page + regression on edit + Import Data menu presence. Logged in as admin/admin123 via browser UI - landed on admin dashboard. Sidebar contains admin-nav-import and admin-nav-master (both present). Opened Master Pertanyaan, selected Ibu Hamil group. Clicked mq-add-button -> mq-add-modal opened. Filled group=ibu_hamil, section=ceklis, text='QA Otomatis - pertanyaan baru', jenis=single (revealed mq-add-opsi), opsi='Ya, Tidak', priority=kuning. Clicked mq-add-save -> success toast 'Pertanyaan ditambahkan' shown. New row appeared (kode IBU_HAMIL_QA_OTOMATIS_PERTAN) with 'BARU' badge, mq-edit-<kode> and mq-delete-<kode> buttons. Regression: opened edit modal on an existing (non-custom) question BUMIL_SUHU, clicked mq-save -> success toast 'Pertanyaan diperbarui'. Cleanup: clicked mq-delete-<new_kode>, window.confirm accepted -> success toast 'Pertanyaan dihapus' and row removed from list. All flows worked without errors.
critical_code_review_comments: MasterQuestions.js AddModal derives 'kode' server-side from text; if two custom questions share the same first ~25 chars/prefix they would collide - consider appending a short random/uuid suffix in create_question to guarantee uniqueness.
server.py remains large (>1000 lines) - suggest splitting into routers as previously flagged.
seed_data_creation: Created test question 'QA Otomatis - pertanyaan baru' (kode IBU_HAMIL_QA_OTOMATIS_PERTAN) under ibu_hamil group and deleted it in the same run. DB state clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New endpoints POST/DELETE /api/master/questions verified via UI. Custom questions get 'custom':true flag which drives the delete button visibility in MasterQuestions.js. Backend kode-generation appears to be derived from group+text prefix (observed: IBU_HAMIL_QA_OTOMATIS_PERTAN).
